shots.detail_en: HOOK SPECTACLE: dawn war room; 3000 beeper pagers arranged in military rows on long tables; Changhong's hand presses the master broadcast key — 3000 green lights ignite at once
shots.sub: 旁白（长虹）：「他有一座交易所。我们有三千台BP机。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: Hongli slams her counter work badge on the table, sliding it toward camera
shots.sub: 红利：「停职就停职。从今天起，同盟的账房，全职。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Mancang drapes a brand-new loud flower shirt over Hongli as the alliance uniform
shots.sub: 满仓：「欢迎入伙！同盟规矩第一条——」红利：「说。」满仓：「账不能错，饭不能省，仓不能空！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: The giant board: Lianhua Network gaps up then dives, one huge green candle smashing down; the whole hall gasps
shots.sub: 散户群：「又来了！这次砸得比上次狠！」
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: Four rapid cuts: green candles hammering down / an old investor fainting into neighbors' arms / a pager torn apart in bare hands / TV replay of Xiong Tiancheng's ten-year-bear-market interview blaring from an old set
shots.sub: 旁白：「糖收了，刀来了。这一次，他要把上次的恐慌，连本带利地放大。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: In the war room Changhong rips the red string off the wall, leaving one giant hand-drawn chart
shots.sub: 长虹：「他这刀，不是砍票的——是砍信心的。票会涨回来，信心砍断了，同盟就死了。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Changhong flips the hand-drawn chart upside down and pins it — its bottom now faces the sky
shots.sub: 长虹：「盘口会说谎，成交量不会——他砸了多少钱，账上就有多少心虚。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Mancang grips the pager master key, staring at Changhong
shots.sub: 满仓：「三千个兄弟，就等你一声哨。这回——全仓还是空仓？」长虹：「不。这回不是守——是搬家。他把网撒下来那天，就是他把底牌亮出来那天。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: EXPLOSIVE SPECTACLE: opening bell; as the green candle keeps hammering, 3000 pagers erupt in green light all across the hall at once, their chirps fusing into a sea-whistle soundwave over the crowd
shots.sub: 长虹（画外）：「蚂蚁们——收网！」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Five rapid cuts: the whole crowd turning away from the sell window / buy slips flying into the window like reversed snow / the green candle eaten notch by notch / Hongli's pen racing across the ledger / Mancang on a desk waving his flower shirt like a flag
shots.sub: 旁白：「十年前，他撒网收走了我父亲。今天，这张网——我们一起把它拖上岸。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: The board: the green candle of Lianhua Network chewed down to a doji and holding
shots.sub: 红利：「吃掉了七成砸盘量！他的刀，钝了！」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: VIP mezzanine; Xiong Wei frowns at the data stream for the first time
shots.sub: 熊伟：「不合规律。散户没有协同方差——除非……他们把我的模型，倒过来用了。」
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Lianhua Tower: Xiong Tiancheng watches the live TV of his own prophecy; his prayer beads stop turning
shots.sub: 熊：「镜头还开着？」熊伟：「开着。全港海市都在看你的十年最大熊市。」熊：「那就让它，错得体面一点。」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: On live TV the host presses Xiong Tiancheng about today's big bullish reversal; he smiles for a long time and says only one sentence
shots.sub: 熊（电视里）：「我从来没有做错过任何事。今天，也不例外。」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: The hall roars with laughter; Mancang slaps his thigh, improvising a mocking jingle about the God of Bears
shots.sub: 满仓：「熊爷说没错过——满仓我服！全厅都涨停了，就他嘴上还是绿的全仓！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Closing board a sea of red; the crowd lifts Changhong over their heads — mirror of EP01 when he stood alone in the corner
shots.sub: 旁白：「十年前，他站在大厅最角落。今天，大厅把他举到了中间。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: High above the crowd Changhong does not smile, looking past the human wave at the red board
shots.sub: 长虹（低语）：「还没完。熊这个人，输完最后一张牌之前——先换桌子。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: After close, Hongli suddenly pulls Changhong into the back alley, grave for the first time
shots.sub: 红利：「我爹打来电话。他让我们今晚去老库房——他说，有个东西等了姓陆的十年。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: An old storeroom: dusty filing cabinets; Hongli's father (back to camera) holds out an old videotape labeled 1993 and a ledger book
shots.sub: 红利爹（画外）：「这带子我看了十年没敢给人看。今天——给你。」
shots.speaker: RED_DAD

shots.detail_en: CLIFF close-up of the tape label: LIANHUA OLD HALL · 1993.6.17
Black screen next-episode card with white bold text
shots.sub: 字幕：「按下播放键之前，长虹犹豫了。」
shots.card: 按下播放键之前，长虹犹豫了。
